more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Propionic acid is an organic acid used for its preservative function in specified foods. Its preservative role is to limit spoilage caused by microorganisms and extend the storage life of the food. The specified material is supplied as colourless liquid.
more_info.daily_intake: For propionic acid: ADI classified as not limited (JECFA, 1997). This evaluation does not establish an ADI for every form in the named group.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern at permitted food concentrations.
Higher-concentration animal exposure caused local digestive-tract changes; human relevance depends on concentration.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain ripened cheese; cheese products; bread and rolls; sweet baked goods; dairy analogues, including beverage whiteners; desserts excluding products covered in categories 1, 3 and 4.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
